description: This file defines the CaptureNode class used within Twig templates to capture output generated by a node for later use, including compilation logic for transforming the node into executable PHP code.

classes.name: CaptureNode
classes.description: A node class in Twig used to capture output from its child nodes, facilitating output buffering and manipulation during template rendering.
